execution.browser_wasm: Six no_std crates compiled; browser execution not run

implementation: RegionQuery connects the selected logical span and canonical bundle owner to final occurrences and resolutions, preserving sparse IDs and bidirectional source correspondence.
Binding records the bundle root and custom maps atomically when an emitter or checked delta is accepted. Guest and host mappings remain isolated even when their generated source bytes match.
The first CBOR receiver owns its sources and reexecutes actual binding before issuing execution proof. Raw ledger validation does not authenticate provider execution.
R048 rename resolves inverse mappings, derived edits and old/new comparison with each occurrence or entity namespace owner. A guest-only mapping cannot authorize editing a host declaration.
Unicode byte boundaries, half-open ranges, stale request identity, invalid input and sticky cancellation/resource stops remain explicit.

independent_review.scope: Fixed RegionQuery27 + R048 rename delta10, unique34; no Math or KaTeX work.
independent_review.findings: Four original probe programs pass on native and WASI. Six definition/reference positions, initial CBOR reception followed by actual binding and query; sparse Custom IDs 5000/7000 with shared generated Unicode source, owner isolation, emitter/delta paths, five invalid raw ledgers and two structurally valid raw self-claims, cancellation preserving accepted map/owner/event; same-owner Unicode rename through sealed candidate parse, actual Custom binding and accept; unchanged R048 counterexample now rejected with no-map positive preserved.
independent_review.limitations: R048 before runs are native only. The first source inventory was captured after Query27 adoption and does not certify that initial binary whole-source identity. The separate before-query27 native rebuild verifies its fixed27 files around the run. After builds verify all34 fixed files before and after and pass native/WASI. Raw result decoders do not mint private execution or communication authority. Root full gates are separate evidence. Absolute include paths are retained in probes; copied input seeds and build commands document their dependencies.

log_normalization: Root logs use LF and a final newline. Independent UTF-8 archive records preserve bytes.
